fixtures.source: Captured with Pueo 0.4.36, WiFi > Packet Monitor, on a home network belonging to magikh0e. Addresses and SSIDs replaced in place by tools/anonymise_capture.py; every length, frame control field and header layout is the captured one.
fixtures.licence: GPL-3.0-or-later, as part of this repository
fixtures.note: Real traffic with no handshake in it, which is the case that cannot be synthesised honestly: 658 frames off an actual radio, malformed ones included, and the parser has to read all of them without a single out-of-bounds access and report no EAPOL at all. A false positive here would be a row on the screen claiming a handshake nobody transmitted. Packet Monitor was in listen-all mode and hopping, so the four-way exchanges implied by the association frames in it were on another channel when they happened.
